definitions.gloss: participation fee, entry fee, registration fee
definitions.explanation: A fee charged for participating in an event, class, competition, or gathering.

examples.japanese: {参加費|さんかひ}は{千円|せんえん}です。
{参加費|さんかひ}には{昼食代|ちゅうしょくだい}が{含|ふく}まれている。
マラソン{大会|たいかい}の{参加費|さんかひ}は{当日|とうじつ}{受付|うけつけ}で{払|はら}ってください。
examples.english: Please pay the marathon entry fee at the reception desk on the day.

notes:
{参加費|さんかひ} is a compound of {参加|さんか} (participation) and {費|ひ} (cost/expense).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {参加費|さんかひ}を{払|はら}う: to pay the participation fee
- {参加費|さんかひ}が{無料|むりょう}: free of charge to participate
- {参加費|さんかひ}{込|こ}み: participation fee included

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {入場料|にゅうじょうりょう}: admission fee (for entering a venue)
- {受講料|じゅこうりょう}: tuition fee (for classes/courses)
- {会費|かいひ}: membership fee, meeting fee
